_doc: EXAMPLE speaker deadline table. Copy to config/speaker-deadlines.<edition>.json and edit. The speaker task definitions (title, audience, completion) live in code and their body text in config/tasks/<edition>/speaker/*.md; this file carries only each task's absolute due date (yyyy-MM-dd), looked up by its stable 'key'. 'title' must keep matching the definition's title exactly. The reminder job mails one reminder, on the due day.

getStartedDeadline._doc: On reminderDate every active speaker whose Get-Started wizard is not complete gets one reminder; the wizard is due by deadline.
